result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d help people become better at understanding one another — not necessarily agreeing, but listening with genuine curiosity, assuming good faith more often, and recognizing the humanity in those they disagree with.

So many of the world’s biggest problems — conflict, inequality, mistrust, even climate inaction — get harder because people struggle to cooperate across difference. If empathy, humility, and clear communication were a little more common, I think countless other changes would become possible.
